name: ROTARY SHAKER
desc: Benchtop Microprocessor-Controlled Rotary Shaker engineered for uniform mixing and culture development. Equipped with a maintenance-free Brushless DC motor, stepless frequency speed control ranging from 15 to 525 RPM, and a compact counterbalance drive mechanism for vibration-free stability.
features: 15 RPM to 525 RPM highly adjustable scale
Universal platform accommodating assorted conical flasks up to 1000 ml
Intelligent Auto-Restart feature after power supply resumption

specifications.Equipment Function: Mixing and development of cultures, chemicals, solvents, and assays
specifications.Speed Control Mechanism: Stepless Frequency Speed Control for smooth acceleration
specifications.Operational Speed Range: 15 RPM to 525 RPM highly adjustable scale
specifications.Stability Mechanism: Compact counter-balance drive mechanism to ensure vibration-free stability
specifications.Platform Configuration: Universal platform with adjustable rollers/surface to hold interchangeable clamps
specifications.Platform Size Dimensions: 300 mm x 300 mm (Standard 12 × 12 Inches workspace layout)
specifications.Maximum Flask Compatibility: Accommodates assorted conical flasks up to 1000 ml volume
specifications.Included 50 ml Clamps: 5 Pieces of high-grade Stainless Steel clamps supplied
specifications.Included 100 ml Clamps: 5 Pieces of high-grade Stainless Steel clamps supplied
specifications.Included 250 ml Clamps: 5 Pieces of high-grade Stainless Steel clamps supplied
specifications.Included 500 ml Clamps: 5 Pieces of high-grade Stainless Steel clamps supplied
specifications.Included 1000 ml Clamps: 5 Pieces of high-grade Stainless Steel clamps supplied
specifications.Monitored Parameters: Continuous tracking of Speed with preset facility and operational parameters
specifications.Integrated Timer Range: Digital programmable timer up to 999 Minutes
specifications.Power Resumption Mode: Intelligent Auto-Restart feature after power supply resumption
specifications.Maximum Batch Volume: Up to 2 Liters total liquid loading capacity
specifications.Motor Safety Features: Smart Overload Protection (LED light flash notification with auto-stop function)
specifications.Enclosure Structure Build: Heavy-Gauge Mild Steel (MS) with industrial protective powder coating
specifications.Physical Dimensions & Weight: 300 mm x 300 mm compact footprint (Net structural weight: 22 Kg)
specifications.Power Supply Requirements: 220 Volts, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable Indian plug setup
